rationale: PINS the review-wave J9 fix (TS parity): #private fields report private visibility — the hardcoded 'public' contradicted metadata.isPrivate on the same symbol. RE-PINNED by the M49 W15 #813 ruling (owner: 'the symbol keeps the declared name'): the member is named `#secret`, not `secret`. The pre-ruling expectation asserted the stripped spelling, which left every reading edge targeting a name no symbol in the graph carried — the join `edge.target -> symbol.name` failed for every private member in both js and ts.
